svg.text: the cold path — and the one that still works with no network
library empty AND no provider ever connected?
REFUSES with no network — and says why
Z-08 ADD A GAME BY HAND
a physical copy is a first-class row

The condition is checked ONCE, at start-up, and never re-checked. A player who deletes every game does not get thrown back into first run — that would be the program telling them they had undone their own setup.
With no network, two of the three doors still open. The closed one is SHOWN, disabled, with its reason — hiding it would make the player think Zerado cannot connect to stores at all.
FLOW - FIRST RUN TO A LIBRARY
How a player gets from an empty machine to a library. First run is a route, not a wizard that owns the session - every door lands on a normal screen.
